findings.title: MFA challenge token accepted as completed authentication
findings.verification: Self-verified with disposable local pg-mem HTTP reproduction; challenge ticket accessed /auth/me and refreshed without OTP. Not exploited on NAS.
findings.recommendation: Reject challenge-purpose tokens in access middleware and enforce separate single-use challenge lifecycle.

findings.title: Revocation and logout leave alternate login credentials active
findings.verification: Self-verified locally: paired JWT still returns 200 after session revocation; opaque session still returns 200 after logout. No NAS mutations.
findings.recommendation: Bind all access credentials to a revocable server-side session and invalidate them consistently.

findings.title: HTTP app entry point and HTTP-compatible login cookies
findings.verification: Live HTTP app responds without redirect; source accepts HTTP login and omits Secure on HTTP. Live authenticated login and HTTPS endpoint untested.
findings.recommendation: Verify canonical HTTPS endpoint, restrict backend exposure and require secure production authentication.
